name: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 Charging Station (Qi2, foldable)
caption:
How many chargers are on your nightstand? 🔋

The Anker MagGo 3-in-1 charges an iPhone, AirPods and an Apple Watch at the same time, with Qi2 magnetic charging, and folds small for a trip.

Tip: Anker recommends a 40W USB-C power adapter to run it at full speed.
